messages:
maria_support: ACME reporting big surge on Dedicated pool in eu-west-1. They saw ~502/503s for ~90s while our API returned queued/waiting. Customer says latency suddenly spiked then errors. Sending minimal repro and logs.

maria_support: log snippet pasted: `2026-03-15T09:12:03Z [proxy] req queued for 95s -> reply 502, autoscaler request_id=0x7f3c`

maria_support: attaching repro steps they ran: `bash -c 'for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d @payload.json & done'`

ops-bot: alert: autoscaler_event id=ae-87234 triggered at 2026-03-15T09:11:52Z for pool=dedicated-eu-west-1-acme. outcome=scale_requested -> blocked_preflight_throttle. see /incidents/ae-87234

raj_oncall: @maria_support can you paste the autoscaler debug lines (headroom, pending, preflight tokens)? Also what was min_replicas and max_replicas for that customer's config?

maria_support: min_replicas=2 max_replicas=50 policy=latency-based target_p99=1500ms scaling_cooldown=10s

maria_support: autoscaler debug: `headroom=0 pending=120 scale_ops_inflight=2 preflight_tokens=0 preflight_queue=14`

devin_runtime: looking at system logs now. We see a flurry of attach failures to cloud infra: `403/429: attach quota exceeded` for ~30s right when scale was requested. The autoscaler kept retrying but our preflight/per-instance attach path is rate-limited by cloud IAM attach API -> returned 429s then we hit internal preflight throttle which blocks new instance launches.

devin_runtime: also noticed the customer's workload is many small concurrent requests that cause fresh model loads -> high memory churn on a small pool. One noisy replica shows OOM/evict thrashing which reduced available capacity further.

jen_custsuccess: customer confirms they started a CI test harness hitting the endpoint at once. They said it was an unintentional load test. They're worried about production impact.

raj_oncall: ok two vectors: (1) cloud attach API throttling -> slows spinups (2) min_replicas too low for this kind of burst + noisy neighbor causing capacity loss. Short term mitigations?

devin_runtime: suggested mitigations: 1) temporarily bump min_replicas to 6 for their pool to provide headroom 2) enable warm_pools for that dedicated pool (pre-warm policy) 3) request quota increase/soft-limit bump from infra provider for attach rate 4) tune autoscaler to allow faster conservative progressive spin (reduce cooldown to 5s for this pool)

maria_support: i offered the customer the temporary bump to min_replicas and asked if they can throttle their CI. They approved the min_replicas change.

maria_support: applying change: `redwoodctl pool update --name dedicated-eu-west-1-acme --min-replicas 6`

ops-bot: audit: pool_update by maria_support at 2026-03-15T09:18:04Z (old_min=2 new_min=6) request_id=upd-12345

devin_runtime: after bump we saw headroom go from 0 -> 4. Autoscaler resumed shorter spinups; errors dropped. But root cause remains: attach rate limit + noisy replica OOM. We should file an engineering task to add retry/backoff smoothing for attach + detect noisy replicas and cordon.

raj_oncall: can you add repro steps for eng-runtime and attach logs? I'll tag eng-runtime on the ticket.

devin_runtime: repro steps I captured: 1) set pool min_replicas=2, disable warm_pool 2) run 200 concurrent small requests with unique prompts to force model loads 3) watch autoscaler logs `kubectl logs -l app=autoscaler -n redwood` filter for `preflight_tokens` and cloud attach 4) observe attach 429s and preflight_queue growth. Commands:```bash
# run repro
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -X POST https://dedicated-eu-west-1-acme.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x$i"}' & done
# tail autoscaler
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=autoscaler --since=2m | grep preflight
```

devin_runtime: included the cloud API trace ids: trace=cloud-attach-98765, cloud-attach-98766 (429 window).

jen_custsuccess: customer accepted temporary min_replicas bump and will throttle CI. They're happy with that for now. Ask eng to push follow-up fixes. :thumbsup:

raj_oncall: filing task ENG-rt-3421 to implement: (A) smoother attach backoff + jitter, (B) better noisy-replica detection (OOM/evict rate), (C) autoscaler policy: temporary emergency headroom option. Tagging @devin_runtime and @eng-runtime.

ops-bot: ticket created ENG-rt-3421 assigned=eng-runtime priority=P2 created_by=raj_oncall link=https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-rt-3421

maria_support: closing loop with customer, asked for post-mortem once eng has a fix. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
